# package diid

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/di/diid"
```

Package diid holds the numeric identifiers of the nodes of the Devices (DI) information model of OPC 10000-100 (the Opc.Ua.Di.NodeSet2 of the OPC Foundation), generated from schema/Opc.Ua.Di.NodeIds.csv by go generate (internal/cmd/gen).

The identifiers belong to the namespace NamespaceURI. Its namespace index differs from server to server: resolve it with the NamespaceArray of the server, for example ua.NewNumericNodeID(ns, diid.DeviceSet).

## Constants

```go
const NamespaceURI = "http://opcfoundation.org/UA/DI/"
```

NamespaceURI is the namespace of the DI information model.
